reviewNotice: English and Hindi were checked by an automated agent, not by a Hindi native speaker. Speech, if available, has not had a human listening review.
privacy: Answers stay only in this open page and clear on reload or restart. Only language and text size are saved. No accounts or tracking.
offline: Once this browser has cached the app’s files, the app can reopen offline. Audio works offline only for clips already cached on this device. Official links need a connection.
audioUnavailable: This narration could not be played. Read the caption; no sound is needed to continue.
historical: A recorded path; its period stays hidden until the reveal. Virtual money and teaching rules only.
introBody: Practise with virtual money, never a real position. Predict first, watch a path, then compare the same path with less exposure.
setupBody: A larger exposure changes how much each move affects virtual money. These choices are not recommendations.
predictionBody: Choose your expectation before the path starts. You can reconsider after seeing the contrast; this is not a test or a forecast.
postQuestion: Would you want a clearer explanation of borrowed exposure?
settlement: After the teaching rule closes a position, its line ends at the settled amount. Later path changes cannot restore that closed position.
comparisonLimit: Both runs use exactly the same recorded path and starting amount. The one-times run continues to the end. If you exited early, the holding time also differs; this is not a test of which choice was better.
pausedPath: The path is paused. Take your time.
glossary: Tap a term for a plain explanation
sourceNote: The full source and reuse evidence are recorded in the project documentation. No real instrument names are shown in this practice.
revealNeutral: These are observed values used for a simplified teaching exercise. The path alone does not explain why values changed, and one episode does not predict another.
nextBody: These official protective resources were checked by an automated agent. They are not recommendations. Opening a link leaves the app and the destination's privacy rules apply.
resourceFallback: If a link cannot open, reconnect and use the official organisation's website. Never share passwords, one-time codes, or account details in response to an unsolicited message.
noResources: No verified links are available in this build. Continue with the explanations here; do not rely on an unverified contact.
externalLink: Opens an external website in a new tab
pilotTitle: Your reflection, on this page only
pilotBody: This is a personal session summary, not collected research or evidence of learning. Copying is optional and puts the text on your device clipboard. Reload or restart clears these answers.
pilotCopyFailed: Could not copy. You can read or select the summary here.
localNotice: Your choices and answers stay on this device. Nothing is sent or tracked.
dataSentNotice: Some features send your inputs to a service. Read their disclosure before using them.
hostLogs: Like any website, the host may keep ordinary server logs, such as requests, IP addresses and browser details. These do not contain your answers.
summaryExposure: At {multiplier} times exposure, {amount} moves with the path.
summaryMove: A 1% path change changes virtual money by {amount}, before a teaching-rule closure.
